en: Colorized vintage postcard view over a tree‑filled park or garden towards a small town. In the middle distance stands a prominent red‑brick public building with pointed gables and arched windows. Behind it stretches a low skyline of light‑colored houses and a tall clock or church tower. The sky is softly tinted with pastel colors suggesting sunrise or sunset. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location and publisher.
